tasks.title: Setup Claude Configuration Structure
tasks.description: Initialize the foundational directory structure and configuration files for Claude AI sub-agents integration
tasks.details: Create .claude/ directory structure with settings.json, commands/ subdirectory, and agent configuration templates. Set up MCP server configuration in .mcp.json. Initialize agent registry and workflow templates following the atomic design pattern. Create base configuration files for backend-agents, frontend-agents, and workflow orchestration as defined in the PRD.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate directory structure exists, configuration files are valid JSON, and all required templates are present. Test that Claude Code can load and parse the configuration files without errors.

subtasks.title: Create Base Directory Structure and Core Configuration
subtasks.description: Initialize .claude/ directory with settings.json, commands/ subdirectory, and .mcp.json file
subtasks.details: Create .claude/ directory at project root. Initialize settings.json with tool allowlist configuration for all required tools (Bash, Read, Write, Edit, etc.). Create commands/ subdirectory for custom slash commands. Create .mcp.json with initial MCP server configuration including name, command, args, and env settings. Ensure all JSON files are valid and properly formatted.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify .claude/ directory exists with correct permissions. Validate settings.json and .mcp.json are valid JSON using JSON schema validation. Check commands/ subdirectory is created and accessible. Test Claude Code can successfully load and parse both configuration files.

subtasks.title: Setup Agent Registry and Base Templates
subtasks.description: Create agent registry structure and base configuration templates for backend and frontend agents
subtasks.details: Create .claude/agents/ directory with registry.json for agent metadata. Initialize backend-agents/ and frontend-agents/ subdirectories. Create base template files: agent-template.json for common agent structure, workflow-template.json for orchestration patterns. Define agent interface with name, description, capabilities, dependencies, and trigger conditions. Set up configuration inheritance model for agent specialization.
subtasks.testStrategy: Validate registry.json contains required fields for each agent type. Verify template files follow atomic design principles. Test that agent configurations can inherit from base templates correctly. Ensure all agent metadata includes proper TypeScript type definitions.

subtasks.title: Configure Workflow Orchestration Templates
subtasks.description: Create workflow orchestration configurations and integration points for CI/CD pipeline
subtasks.details: Create .claude/workflows/ directory with orchestration templates. Define workflow configurations for: pre-commit validation flow, PR review pipeline, deployment preparation workflow, and rollback procedures. Create integration hooks for existing Git hooks and CI/CD systems. Configure agent chaining rules and parallel execution strategies. Set up workflow state management and logging configuration.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify workflow templates contain valid orchestration rules. Test workflow configurations can be parsed by task-master integration. Validate integration hooks match existing CI/CD pipeline requirements. Ensure workflow state transitions are properly defined and logged.

subtasks.title: Initialize Development Environment Integration
subtasks.description: Set up environment-specific configurations and PNPM workspace integration
subtasks.details: Create environment-specific configuration files for development, staging, and production. Configure .claude/settings.json with PNPM-specific tool configurations. Set up agent access to PNPM workspace structure and monorepo paths. Create .claude/commands/init.md for quick agent initialization. Configure API key management through .env integration. Set up agent resource limits matching Vitest constraints (max threads, timeouts).
subtasks.testStrategy: Test agents can access PNPM workspace packages correctly. Verify environment variables are properly loaded from .env. Validate resource limits prevent CPU overload. Test custom slash commands execute correctly. Ensure all PNPM commands are used instead of npm equivalents.

tasks.title: Implement Backend Development Agents
tasks.description: Create API Development Agent and Database Management Agent with Express v5 and Prisma support
tasks.details: Implement API Development Agent with capabilities for Express route generation, Prisma schema updates, service layer creation with Zod validation, and API documentation. Create Database Management Agent for Prisma schema changes, migration generation/validation, seed data scripts, and query optimization. Use templates for controller, service, and route generation. Integrate with existing PNPM workspace structure.
tasks.testStrategy: Test agent can generate valid Express routes with proper middleware, create Prisma migrations that pass validation, generate service layer code that follows project patterns, and produce working API endpoints with documentation.

subtasks.title: Create API Development Agent Core
subtasks.description: Implement the core API Development Agent with Express v5 route generation and Prisma schema integration capabilities
subtasks.details: Build the foundation of the API Development Agent including: Express v5 route generation with proper middleware support, Prisma schema update detection and handling, service layer creation with Zod validation schemas, and API documentation generation using OpenAPI/Swagger specifications. Create template system for controllers, services, and routes that follow project patterns. Ensure integration with existing PNPM workspace structure and TypeScript configuration.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify agent can generate valid Express v5 routes with proper error handling and middleware chain, create Prisma schema updates that compile without errors, generate Zod validation schemas that match Prisma models, and produce OpenAPI documentation that accurately reflects generated endpoints. Test template system produces code following project conventions.

subtasks.title: Create Database Management Agent
subtasks.description: Implement the Database Management Agent for Prisma migration management and query optimization
subtasks.details: Develop the Database Management Agent with capabilities for: Prisma schema change detection and migration generation, migration validation and rollback strategies, seed data script generation for development and testing environments, and query optimization recommendations. Include support for database introspection, index suggestions, and performance monitoring integration. Ensure proper handling of migration conflicts and database state management.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test agent correctly generates Prisma migrations that pass validation and can be applied/rolled back safely, produces seed data scripts that work across different environments, identifies query optimization opportunities with measurable performance improvements, and handles migration conflicts gracefully without data loss.

subtasks.title: Implement Agent Command Interface and Integration
subtasks.description: Create the command interface system for both agents and integrate with existing development workflow
subtasks.details: Build command interface supporting: /api-generate for creating new API endpoints with full stack (route, controller, service, validation), /db-migrate for schema changes and migration management, /db-seed for test data generation, and /api-docs for documentation updates. Implement auto-triggering on file changes for relevant agent actions. Ensure seamless integration with existing task-master workflow and CLAUDE.md context.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify all commands execute correctly and produce expected outputs, auto-triggering works based on file change patterns without false positives, integration with task-master maintains proper task status updates, and generated code follows all project conventions including PNPM usage and TypeScript strict mode.

subtasks.title: Add Template System and Project Pattern Compliance
subtasks.description: Implement comprehensive template system and ensure all generated code follows project patterns
subtasks.details: Create extensible template system for: Express controllers with proper error handling and middleware, service layer with dependency injection patterns, Prisma repository patterns with transaction support, and Zod validation schemas with custom validators. Ensure all templates follow project conventions including TypeScript strict mode, ESLint rules, proper imports structure, and PNPM workspace compatibility. Include template customization options and project-specific overrides.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test templates generate code that passes all linting and TypeScript checks, follows established project patterns for error handling and logging, integrates properly with existing authentication and authorization middleware, and maintains consistency across all generated files. Verify customization options work correctly for project-specific needs.

tasks.title: Implement Frontend Development Agents
tasks.description: Create Component Development Agent and State Management Agent for React 19 with Vite 6
tasks.details: Implement Component Development Agent following atomic design principles with React 19, Tailwind CSS, and Storybook story generation. Create State Management Agent for TanStack Query hooks, context providers, WebSocket connections, and performance optimization. Generate templates for atoms, molecules, and organisms. Ensure WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance and integration with existing Vite 6 build system.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate generated components render correctly, follow atomic design patterns, include proper TypeScript types, have corresponding Storybook stories, and pass accessibility audits. Test state management hooks work with TanStack Query and context providers function correctly.

subtasks.title: Create Component Development Agent Core Infrastructure
subtasks.description: Build the foundational Component Development Agent with atomic design pattern support and template generation system
subtasks.details: Implement core agent structure with command parsing for component generation. Create template system for atoms, molecules, and organisms following atomic design principles. Include React 19 component scaffolding with TypeScript interfaces, prop validation, and automatic file organization. Integrate with existing Vite 6 build system and ensure proper module resolution.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify agent correctly parses component generation commands, generates valid React 19 components with proper TypeScript types, creates files in correct atomic design folders, and templates compile without errors in Vite 6 environment

subtasks.title: Integrate Tailwind CSS and Storybook Story Generation
subtasks.description: Add Tailwind CSS styling system and automatic Storybook story generation to Component Development Agent
subtasks.details: Extend Component Development Agent to include Tailwind CSS class generation with design system tokens. Implement automatic Storybook story file generation for each component with controls, args, and documentation. Create utility functions for common styling patterns and responsive design. Ensure generated stories follow Storybook 7+ Component Story Format.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test that generated components include appropriate Tailwind classes, Storybook stories render correctly with proper controls, design tokens are consistently applied, and stories display in Storybook UI without errors

subtasks.title: Implement State Management Agent with TanStack Query
subtasks.description: Create State Management Agent for managing application state, API integration, and WebSocket connections
subtasks.details: Build State Management Agent with TanStack Query hook generation for API calls, including error handling, caching, and optimistic updates. Implement context provider templates for global state management. Add WebSocket connection management with reconnection logic and event handling. Include performance optimization through query invalidation strategies and selective re-rendering patterns.
subtasks.testStrategy: Validate generated TanStack Query hooks handle API calls correctly with proper error states, context providers manage state without unnecessary re-renders, WebSocket connections maintain stability with auto-reconnect, and performance optimizations reduce component re-renders by at least 30%

subtasks.title: Add WCAG 2.1 AA Accessibility Compliance and Testing
subtasks.description: Implement accessibility features and automated testing for both Component and State Management agents
subtasks.details: Enhance both agents to ensure WCAG 2.1 AA compliance in generated code. Add automatic ARIA attributes, keyboard navigation support, and focus management to component templates. Implement accessibility testing integration using axe-core or similar tools. Create accessibility documentation and best practices guide. Include screen reader compatibility checks and color contrast validation.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify all generated components pass automated accessibility audits, keyboard navigation works correctly, ARIA attributes are properly applied, color contrast meets WCAG standards, and screen reader announcements are appropriate for interactive elements

tasks.title: Implement Testing Agents
tasks.description: Create Backend Testing Agent and Frontend Testing Agent with comprehensive test coverage
tasks.details: Implement Backend Testing Agent using Jest for unit tests, integration tests for APIs, external dependency mocking, test data factories, and performance testing. Create Frontend Testing Agent using Vitest for component tests, Playwright for E2E tests, visual regression testing, and accessibility testing. Auto-trigger on code changes and maintain 80% coverage threshold. Integrate with existing test:watch limitations and resource constraints.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify agents generate comprehensive test suites with proper mocking, achieve required coverage thresholds, tests pass in CI pipeline, and performance tests identify bottlenecks. Test auto-triggering works correctly and respects resource limits.

subtasks.title: Create Backend Testing Agent Core Framework
subtasks.description: Build the foundational Backend Testing Agent with Jest integration, test runner capabilities, and code analysis features
subtasks.details: Develop the core Backend Testing Agent architecture with Jest test runner integration, code parsing capabilities for automatic test generation, test file creation and management, coverage reporting integration, and command-line interface for manual triggering. Implement base classes for unit test generation, integration test templates, and test data factory patterns. Ensure compatibility with existing Jest configuration and resource constraints.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify agent can parse backend code files, generate valid Jest test suites, execute tests with proper resource limits, produce accurate coverage reports, and handle various code patterns including Express routes, middleware, and database models.

subtasks.title: Implement Frontend Testing Agent with Vitest and Playwright
subtasks.description: Create Frontend Testing Agent supporting component testing with Vitest and E2E testing with Playwright
subtasks.details: Build Frontend Testing Agent with Vitest integration for component unit tests, React Testing Library support, Playwright setup for E2E testing, visual regression testing capabilities using Percy or similar tools, and accessibility testing with axe-core. Implement smart test generation based on component props and state, user interaction simulation, and cross-browser testing support. Include performance budgets and test execution optimization.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test agent generates valid Vitest component tests, Playwright E2E tests run successfully across browsers, visual regression baselines are established and maintained, accessibility violations are detected and reported, and test execution respects CPU and memory limits.

subtasks.title: Develop Test Generation Intelligence and Mocking System
subtasks.description: Implement intelligent test case generation with comprehensive mocking capabilities for both backend and frontend agents
subtasks.details: Create intelligent test generation system that analyzes code structure to identify test scenarios, generates comprehensive test cases covering edge cases and error handling, implements automatic mocking for external dependencies (APIs, databases, third-party services), creates test data factories with realistic data generation, and maintains test isolation. Include performance test generation for critical paths and load testing scenarios.
subtasks.testStrategy: Validate generated tests cover happy paths and edge cases, mocks properly isolate external dependencies, test data is realistic and varied, performance tests accurately measure bottlenecks, and generated tests maintain independence and can run in parallel.

subtasks.title: Integrate Auto-triggering and Coverage Enforcement
subtasks.description: Implement automatic test triggering on code changes with coverage threshold enforcement and CI/CD integration
subtasks.details: Develop file watcher system for automatic test triggering on code changes, implement coverage threshold enforcement (80% minimum) with reporting, create pre-commit hooks for test execution, integrate with CI/CD pipeline for continuous testing, and build coverage trend tracking with alerts for coverage drops. Include test result caching for unchanged code, parallel test execution optimization, and integration with existing development workflow respecting resource constraints.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify file changes trigger appropriate tests, coverage thresholds block commits when not met, CI pipeline integration works smoothly, test execution is optimized to avoid redundant runs, and system respects CPU/memory limits while maintaining fast feedback loops.

tasks.title: Implement Code Review Agent
tasks.description: Create automated code quality and security validation agent
tasks.details: Implement Code Review Agent with ESLint rule enforcement, TypeScript strict mode compliance, security vulnerability scanning using existing tools, performance optimization suggestions, and architecture pattern validation. Integrate with pre-commit hooks and PR creation triggers. Include /review command for manual reviews and automatic triggering on code changes.
tasks.testStrategy: Test agent correctly identifies code quality issues, enforces TypeScript strict mode, catches security vulnerabilities, provides actionable performance suggestions, and integrates smoothly with Git workflow without blocking legitimate changes.

subtasks.title: Design and Implement Core Code Review Engine
subtasks.description: Create the foundational code review engine with pluggable analyzers for ESLint, TypeScript strict mode, and security scanning
subtasks.details: Build core review engine architecture with analyzer plugin system. Implement ESLint analyzer to enforce project rules, TypeScript strict mode analyzer to check compliance, and security scanner integration using existing tools. Create unified result format for all analyzers with severity levels, file locations, and fix suggestions. Implement configuration system for enabling/disabling specific checks and customizing rule severity.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit test each analyzer independently with sample code containing known issues. Test plugin system can dynamically load analyzers. Verify result aggregation correctly merges findings from multiple analyzers. Test configuration changes properly enable/disable checks.

subtasks.title: Implement Performance and Architecture Analysis
subtasks.description: Create analyzers for performance optimization suggestions and architecture pattern validation
subtasks.details: Develop performance analyzer to detect common performance anti-patterns like unnecessary re-renders, unoptimized loops, and memory leaks. Implement architecture validator to check adherence to project patterns including proper layering, dependency injection usage, and component structure. Create suggestion engine that provides actionable optimization recommendations with code examples. Integrate with existing codebase patterns and conventions.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test performance analyzer catches known anti-patterns in sample code. Verify architecture validator identifies violations of project conventions. Test suggestion engine provides relevant and actionable recommendations. Validate against real project code for false positive rate.

subtasks.title: Integrate with Git Hooks and PR Workflow
subtasks.description: Set up pre-commit hooks and PR creation triggers for automatic code review
subtasks.details: Implement pre-commit hook integration that runs lightweight checks without blocking commits. Create PR webhook handler for comprehensive review on pull request creation. Implement review comment posting to GitHub PRs with inline suggestions. Add bypass mechanism for emergency fixes. Configure selective review based on changed files and commit messages. Ensure integration respects existing Git workflow and doesn't introduce friction.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test pre-commit hooks run quickly and don't block legitimate commits. Verify PR integration posts meaningful comments without spam. Test bypass mechanism works for emergency commits. Validate selective review correctly identifies files needing review.

subtasks.title: Create Manual Review Command and Reporting
subtasks.description: Implement /review command for on-demand reviews and create comprehensive reporting system
subtasks.details: Build /review slash command that accepts file paths, directories, or commit ranges for targeted review. Implement interactive mode for reviewing findings and applying fixes. Create summary reports with metrics on code quality trends, common issues, and improvement suggestions. Add export functionality for reports in JSON and Markdown formats. Implement caching to avoid re-analyzing unchanged code.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test /review command correctly parses various input formats and targets appropriate code. Verify interactive mode allows users to review and apply fixes seamlessly. Test report generation produces accurate metrics and trends. Validate caching improves performance without missing new issues.

tasks.title: Implement Documentation Agent
tasks.description: Create automated documentation generation and maintenance system
tasks.details: Implement Documentation Agent for API documentation generation from code annotations, README file updates, Mermaid architecture diagrams, CLAUDE.md context maintenance, and release notes from commits. Auto-trigger after feature completion and provide /docs command. Generate documentation in docs/ folder following project structure guidelines.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate generated API documentation is accurate and complete, README files are updated correctly, architecture diagrams reflect actual system structure, and release notes capture meaningful changes. Test documentation stays synchronized with code changes.

subtasks.title: Create Documentation Generator Core Engine
subtasks.description: Build the foundational documentation generation engine with plugin architecture for different documentation types
subtasks.details: Implement core documentation engine with TypeScript AST parsing for API documentation extraction from JSDoc/TSDoc annotations, plugin system for extensible documentation formats, template engine for consistent documentation output, and configuration management for documentation preferences. Create base classes for documentation generators and establish interfaces for different documentation types (API, architecture, release notes).
subtasks.testStrategy: Test AST parser correctly extracts documentation from various code annotation formats, plugin system loads and executes documentation plugins correctly, template engine produces consistent output across different documentation types, and configuration changes are properly applied to generation process.

subtasks.title: Implement API Documentation Generator
subtasks.description: Create automated API documentation generator that extracts and formats documentation from code annotations
subtasks.details: Build API documentation generator that parses TypeScript/JavaScript files for JSDoc/TSDoc comments, extracts endpoint definitions with parameters and response types, generates OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, creates markdown documentation with examples, and organizes documentation by module/service. Include support for REST APIs, GraphQL schemas, and WebSocket events. Generate interactive API documentation using tools like Swagger UI.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify generator correctly parses all API annotation formats, produces valid OpenAPI specifications, includes all required fields and examples, handles edge cases like optional parameters and complex types, and generated documentation is browsable and accurate.

subtasks.title: Build Architecture Diagram and README Generator
subtasks.description: Implement generators for Mermaid architecture diagrams and automated README updates
subtasks.details: Create architecture diagram generator that analyzes codebase structure to generate Mermaid diagrams showing component relationships, data flow, and system architecture. Implement README generator that updates project documentation with latest features, installation instructions, API endpoints, and configuration options. Include CLAUDE.md context maintenance for AI assistant integration. Follow Google Cloud Platform diagramming style guidelines.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test diagram generator produces valid Mermaid syntax, accurately represents system architecture, updates reflect code changes, README sections are properly formatted and complete, and CLAUDE.md context remains relevant and up-to-date.

subtasks.title: Create Release Notes Generator and Integration
subtasks.description: Build automated release notes generation from commits and integrate documentation triggers
subtasks.details: Implement release notes generator that analyzes git commits to extract meaningful changes, groups changes by type (features, fixes, breaking changes), generates changelog in standard format, and creates version-specific documentation. Add auto-trigger mechanisms for documentation generation after feature completion, pre-commit hooks for documentation validation, and /docs command for manual documentation generation. Ensure all documentation is generated in docs/ folder with proper categorization.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify release notes accurately capture commit changes, categorization follows conventional commit standards, auto-triggers execute at correct lifecycle points, /docs command generates complete documentation set, and all documentation is properly organized in docs/ folder structure.

tasks.title: Implement Workflow Orchestration System
tasks.description: Create workflow engine for coordinating multiple agents in feature development and bug fixes
tasks.details: Implement workflow orchestration engine supporting feature development, bug fix, and refactoring workflows as defined in PRD. Create parallel execution for backend/frontend agents, sequential validation steps, and conditional logic based on change types. Include workflow templates in YAML format and integration with task-master commands. Support both automatic triggering and manual /feature commands.
tasks.testStrategy: Test workflows execute in correct sequence, parallel steps complete successfully, conditional logic works properly, workflows integrate with existing task-master system, and error handling gracefully manages failed steps.

subtasks.title: Design Workflow Engine Core Architecture
subtasks.description: Design and implement the core workflow engine with support for parallel/sequential execution and conditional logic
subtasks.details: Create the foundational workflow engine that can parse workflow definitions, manage execution state, handle parallel and sequential task execution, and implement conditional branching based on workflow types (feature, bug fix, refactoring). Design the engine to be extensible and integrate with the existing task-master system. Include interfaces for workflow steps, execution context, and state management.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit test the workflow engine for correct state transitions, parallel execution handling, conditional logic evaluation, and error propagation. Test integration with task-master commands and verify workflow persistence/recovery mechanisms.

subtasks.title: Implement YAML Workflow Template System
subtasks.description: Create YAML-based workflow template parser and validator with predefined templates for common workflows
subtasks.details: Develop a YAML parser for workflow definitions that supports defining steps, dependencies, parallel execution blocks, conditional logic, and agent assignments. Create template library with predefined workflows for feature development, bug fixes, and refactoring. Include schema validation, template inheritance, and variable substitution capabilities. Store templates in .taskmaster/workflows/ directory.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test YAML parsing with valid and invalid templates, verify schema validation catches errors, test template inheritance and variable substitution, and ensure predefined templates execute correctly through the workflow engine.

subtasks.title: Build Agent Coordination and Communication Layer
subtasks.description: Implement the communication system for coordinating multiple agents within workflows
subtasks.details: Create the coordination layer that manages agent lifecycle, handles inter-agent communication, manages shared context between agents, and implements result aggregation. Support parallel agent execution for backend/frontend development, implement queuing for sequential validation steps, and handle agent failures with retry logic. Include agent status tracking and progress reporting.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test parallel agent execution completes successfully, verify sequential steps wait for dependencies, test failure handling and retry mechanisms, validate shared context is properly maintained between agents, and ensure progress tracking accurately reflects workflow state.

subtasks.title: Integrate Workflow Commands and Triggers
subtasks.description: Implement task-master command integration and automatic workflow triggering system
subtasks.details: Create /feature command for manual workflow triggering, implement automatic triggers based on task-master events (task creation, status changes), and integrate with existing CLI infrastructure. Add workflow status commands, workflow history tracking, and ability to pause/resume workflows. Implement webhook support for external triggers and ensure workflows respect existing resource constraints.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test /feature command correctly initiates workflows, verify automatic triggers fire on appropriate events, test pause/resume functionality maintains workflow state, validate webhook triggers work correctly, and ensure integration doesn't break existing task-master commands.

tasks.title: Implement CI/CD Pipeline Integration
tasks.description: Integrate Claude agents with existing CI/CD pipeline and Git hooks
tasks.details: Integrate agents with pre-commit, pull request, and deployment pipelines as specified in PRD. Configure pre-commit hooks for lint, type-check, format validation, and Claude review. Set up PR pipeline with build validation, full test suite, coverage reporting, and performance audits. Implement staging/production deployment with smoke tests, monitoring setup, and rollback preparation. Use PNPM commands throughout.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify pre-commit hooks prevent bad commits, PR pipeline catches issues before merge, deployment pipeline successfully deploys to staging/production, monitoring and rollback systems work correctly, and all integrations use PNPM exclusively.

subtasks.title: Configure Pre-commit Hooks Integration
subtasks.description: Set up pre-commit hooks with Claude agent integration for automated code quality checks
subtasks.details: Install and configure pre-commit framework with hooks for ESLint, TypeScript strict mode checking, Prettier formatting validation, and Claude review agent. Create .pre-commit-config.yaml with proper hook configurations. Ensure hooks use PNPM commands exclusively (pnpm run lint, pnpm run typecheck, pnpm run format:check). Add Claude review hook that triggers the code review agent for staged changes. Configure hook failure handling and provide clear error messages.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test pre-commit hooks by attempting commits with linting errors, type errors, and formatting issues. Verify Claude review agent is triggered and provides feedback. Ensure hooks prevent bad commits while allowing valid ones. Test that all hooks use PNPM commands and respect resource limits.

subtasks.title: Implement Pull Request Pipeline
subtasks.description: Create comprehensive PR pipeline with Claude agent integration for automated validation and reporting
subtasks.details: Set up GitHub Actions workflow for pull requests including build validation with PNPM, full test suite execution (backend Jest, frontend Vitest/Playwright), code coverage reporting with 80% threshold enforcement, and performance audit integration. Configure Claude agents to run automatically: Code Review Agent for quality checks, Testing Agents for test generation if coverage is low, and Documentation Agent for API changes. Implement parallel job execution for efficiency and add status checks required for merge.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create test PRs with various scenarios: failing tests, low coverage, performance regressions, and documentation gaps. Verify pipeline catches all issues, Claude agents provide helpful feedback, coverage reports are accurate, and all checks must pass before merge. Test pipeline performance and ensure it completes within reasonable time.

subtasks.title: Setup Deployment Pipeline with Staging/Production
subtasks.description: Implement automated deployment pipeline with Claude DevOps agent integration for staging and production environments
subtasks.details: Create deployment workflows for staging and production using GitHub Actions. Integrate DevOps Agent for Docker image building, Kubernetes manifest generation, and environment-specific configurations. Implement smoke tests that run post-deployment, monitoring setup with Datadog integration, and automated rollback preparation. Configure deployment gates with manual approval for production. Ensure all deployment scripts use PNPM for consistency. Add deployment status notifications and success metrics tracking.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test deployment to staging environment with various scenarios: successful deployments, failed smoke tests triggering rollback, configuration errors, and monitoring alert generation. Verify DevOps Agent correctly generates Docker and K8s configs. Test production deployment approval process and rollback mechanisms. Ensure monitoring captures deployment metrics.

subtasks.title: Integrate Monitoring and Rollback Systems
subtasks.description: Implement comprehensive monitoring integration and automated rollback capabilities for the CI/CD pipeline
subtasks.details: Set up Datadog monitoring for CI/CD pipeline metrics including build times, test execution duration, deployment success rates, and rollback frequency. Implement automated rollback triggers based on failed smoke tests, performance degradation, or error rate spikes. Create dashboards for pipeline health, deployment history, and agent performance metrics. Configure alerts for pipeline failures, long-running jobs, and deployment issues. Integrate rollback system with Git for automatic revert commits when needed.
subtasks.testStrategy: Simulate deployment failures to test automatic rollback triggers. Verify monitoring captures all pipeline metrics accurately. Test alert configurations by introducing controlled failures. Validate dashboards show real-time pipeline status and historical trends. Ensure rollback system correctly reverts both code and infrastructure changes.

tasks.title: Implement DevOps Agent
tasks.description: Create infrastructure and deployment management agent
tasks.details: Implement DevOps Agent for Docker configuration updates, Kubernetes manifest generation, CI/CD pipeline optimization, environment variable management, and performance monitoring setup. Include /deploy command for environment-specific deployments and integration with existing infrastructure. Support staging and production environments with proper health checks and rollback capabilities.
tasks.testStrategy: Test agent generates valid Docker configurations, Kubernetes manifests deploy successfully, environment variables are managed securely, monitoring systems capture relevant metrics, and deployment processes complete without errors across all target environments.

subtasks.title: Create DevOps Agent Core Infrastructure
subtasks.description: Build the foundational DevOps agent with Docker and Kubernetes configuration management capabilities
subtasks.details: Implement base DevOps agent class with Docker configuration parser and generator, Kubernetes manifest templates for deployments/services/configmaps, environment-specific configuration management system, and integration with existing .taskmaster agent framework. Include support for multi-stage Docker builds, resource limits, and health check configurations.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test Docker configurations parse and generate correctly, Kubernetes manifests are valid YAML with proper resource definitions, environment variables are correctly interpolated, and agent integrates properly with TaskMaster command structure

subtasks.title: Implement CI/CD Pipeline Optimization
subtasks.description: Create CI/CD pipeline analysis and optimization features with automated improvement suggestions
subtasks.details: Build pipeline analyzer for GitHub Actions workflows, implement optimization recommendations for build times and resource usage, create caching strategy suggestions, add parallel job configuration optimizer, and develop automated dependency update workflows. Include analysis of test execution times and bottleneck identification.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify pipeline analysis correctly identifies optimization opportunities, generated workflow configurations are valid and improve build times, caching strategies reduce redundant operations, and parallel configurations maintain correct dependencies

subtasks.title: Build Deployment Command System
subtasks.description: Implement /deploy command with environment-specific deployment capabilities and rollback support
subtasks.details: Create /deploy command handler with staging/production environment support, implement health check monitoring during deployments, build automated rollback mechanism on failure detection, add deployment status tracking and notifications, and create deployment history logging. Include blue-green deployment pattern support and database migration coordination.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test deployment commands execute correctly for each environment, health checks accurately determine deployment success, rollback mechanisms restore previous versions reliably, and deployment history is accurately tracked with proper error handling

subtasks.title: Integrate Performance Monitoring Setup
subtasks.description: Implement performance monitoring configuration and automated alerting setup for deployed applications
subtasks.details: Build monitoring configuration generator for application metrics, create automated dashboard setup for key performance indicators, implement alerting rules for resource usage and error rates, add log aggregation configuration, and integrate with existing monitoring systems. Include custom metric definitions and SLO/SLA tracking configurations.
subtasks.testStrategy: Validate monitoring configurations deploy successfully, metrics are collected and visible in dashboards, alerts trigger appropriately for defined thresholds, and integration with existing monitoring infrastructure works seamlessly

tasks.title: Implement Monitoring and Performance Optimization
tasks.description: Set up comprehensive monitoring, metrics collection, and automated performance optimization
tasks.details: Implement monitoring system with performance baselines, automated optimization suggestions, success metrics tracking (40% faster development, 90% test coverage, 95% first-time PR approval), and alerting for critical issues. Create dashboards for development velocity, code quality metrics, and team satisfaction scores. Include automated reporting and trend analysis. Integrate with existing development workflow.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify monitoring captures all defined success metrics, performance baselines are established and maintained, optimization suggestions improve actual performance, alerts trigger appropriately for critical issues, and dashboards provide actionable insights for continuous improvement.

subtasks.title: Set Up Monitoring Infrastructure and Metrics Collection
subtasks.description: Configure comprehensive monitoring system with metrics collection for development velocity, code quality, and performance baselines
subtasks.details: Install and configure monitoring infrastructure (Prometheus/Grafana or similar) with custom metrics exporters. Set up collectors for development velocity metrics (PR approval rates, deployment frequency, lead time), code quality metrics (test coverage, linting scores, TypeScript compliance), and performance baselines (build times, test execution times, application response times). Configure data retention policies and establish baseline measurements for all success metrics (40% faster development, 90% test coverage, 95% first-time PR approval).
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify monitoring infrastructure successfully collects all defined metrics, data is persisted according to retention policies, baseline measurements are accurately captured, and metrics exporters integrate properly with the development workflow without performance impact

subtasks.title: Create Performance Dashboards and Visualization
subtasks.description: Build comprehensive dashboards for real-time visualization of success metrics, development velocity, and team satisfaction scores
subtasks.details: Design and implement interactive dashboards using Grafana or similar tools. Create views for development velocity (PR turnaround time, deployment frequency), code quality metrics (coverage trends, technical debt), team satisfaction scores (survey integration), and performance optimization opportunities. Include drill-down capabilities, historical trend analysis, and customizable time ranges. Implement role-based access control and mobile-responsive layouts for accessibility.
subtasks.testStrategy: Validate dashboards display accurate real-time data, historical trends are correctly calculated, drill-down functionality works across all metric types, and dashboards load efficiently on both desktop and mobile devices

subtasks.title: Implement Alerting and Automated Optimization System
subtasks.description: Configure intelligent alerting for critical issues and build automated performance optimization suggestions
subtasks.details: Set up multi-channel alerting system (Slack, email, PagerDuty) with intelligent thresholds for critical metrics: test coverage drops below 90%, PR approval rate falls below 95%, build times exceed baselines by 20%, or deployment failures. Implement ML-based anomaly detection for proactive issue identification. Create automated optimization engine that analyzes performance data and suggests improvements (dependency updates, build optimization, test parallelization). Include alert suppression and escalation policies.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test alerts trigger appropriately for all defined thresholds, optimization suggestions are actionable and improve actual performance, anomaly detection identifies real issues without false positives, and alert routing works correctly across all channels

subtasks.title: Build Automated Reporting and Workflow Integration
subtasks.description: Create automated reporting system with trend analysis and seamless integration into existing development workflow
subtasks.details: Develop automated weekly/monthly reports summarizing key metrics, trend analysis, and achievement of success targets. Implement API endpoints for programmatic access to metrics data. Create GitHub/GitLab integrations to display relevant metrics in PRs and commits. Build CLI tools for developers to check their personal metrics. Set up automated report distribution via email and Slack. Include executive summaries with actionable insights and recommendations for continuous improvement.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify reports are generated on schedule with accurate data, API endpoints return correct metrics, GitHub/GitLab integrations display relevant information without cluttering UI, and CLI tools provide quick access to personal and team metrics
